svg.title: STEP 1: share of participants reaching each weight-loss threshold at week 68
svg.desc: Semaglutide 2.4 mg vs placebo, both with lifestyle intervention. At least 5%: 86.4% vs 31.5%. At least 10%: 69.1% vs 12.0%. At least 15%: 50.5% vs 4.9%. At least 20%: 32.0% vs 1.7%. Observed among participants with week-68 weight data (1212 semaglutide, 577 placebo).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
